source.title: SAMPLE COSTS TO PRODUCE PROCESSING TOMATOES
source.counties: Sacramento Counties Brenna Aegerter UC Cooperative Extension Farm Advisor, San Joaquin
source.publisher: UC Davis Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics / UC Cooperative Extension

priceYear.quote: Input prices and interest rates are based on January 2017 values.

acresFarmed.quote: The hypothetical field and row-crop farm consists of 3,500 non-contiguous acres of rented land at 12% of gross tomato revenue for this budget.

acresCrop.quote: Tomatoes are transplanted on 1,000 acres, all sub-surface drip irrigated as two-thirds of the local tomato acreage is estimated to be sub-surface drip irrigated.

yieldStatement.quote: In this study, a yield of 44 tons per acre is used.

priceStatement.quote: A price of $72.50 per ton is used in this study which reflects the statewide crop price in 2016.

costsPerAcre.title: CULTURAL COSTS PER ACRE TO PRODUCE PROCESSING TOMATOES (SDI)

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: [{Purchase Price - Salvage Value} x Capital Recovery Factor] + [Salvage Value x Interest Rate]

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.

machineLaborFactor.quote: The labor for operations involving machinery is 20% higher than the field operation time to account for equipment set up, road travel, maintenance, and repair and downtime.

monthly.quote: MONTHLY CASH COSTS PER ACRE TO PRODUCE PROCESSING TOMATOES (SDI)
